purpose: Frozen experimental designs that map a claim_id to a paired baseline/treatment comparison. dv_claim_experiment_gate.py refuses any request whose claim has no entry here.

design_required_fields.corpus_slices: map slice_id -> {path, sha256}; frozen corpus slices only. For FREE_TIER_MICROBATCH_PROFILES the slice is a dv-free-tier-microbatch-slice-v1 manifest with 1..5 tasks, each with a pinned bundle
design_required_fields.verifier_files: list of {path, sha256}; oracle/verifier files pinned and re-checked after execution. An empty list blocks the plan
design_required_fields.estimated_usd_per_run: map arm -> number; pre-run estimate used for the budget gate. Free-quota arms may use 0.0 (tokens are still accounted)
design_required_fields.arm_profiles: FREE_TIER_MICROBATCH_PROFILES only: map arm -> frozen profile (observation_elision none | keep_last_k with k)
design_required_fields.timeouts_ms: frozen executor and run timeouts (informational until the execution adapter exists)

C-T1.claim_proxy_note: C-T1 concerns rule-based elision BEFORE LLM summarization. This design tests only the rule-based elision of old observations (no LLM summary stage). It is a partial proxy and cannot confirm or refute C-T1 as stated.
C-T1.design_note: Pilot micro-batch (3 tasks, 1 run per arm). Not a statistical sample; INCONCLUSIVE is an admissible outcome.
blocking_reasons_at_registration: FT-S2-MB3-01: all three S2-W01 task bundles are NOT_MATERIALIZED (unchanged in revision 2)

Added slice FT-PY-MB3-01: 3 synthetic Python micro-tasks with pinned bundles and unittest oracles. Pins verifier_files. FT-S2-MB3-01 entry and its manifest are unchanged and remain blocked (S2 candidates not materialized). Not a substitution of S2 identity.
